rule_or_pattern: Drop lines whose label spans two print lines: flag C:cpp_vs_book_out, OR label matches a mid-label hyphen break [α-ωά-ώΑ-Ω]- [α-ωά-ώ] (e.g. 'Κυ- βέρνησης'), OR a split word [α-ωά-ώ]{2,} [α-ωά-ώ]{1,2}\b in the mid-label position as in 'ανθρωπιστι κά'; additionally drop C:cph_out_of_range lines on pages p015 and p019, where crops and labels are misaligned.
notes: 1988 parliament minutes in a worn monotonic face; most lines read correctly (1-11, 14-20, 31, 33, 34, 36). But on pages p015/p019 a block of labels carries the text of the next print line as well while the crop shows one line plus a sliver ('Είναι απόφαση της Κυ- βέρνησης, είναι πολιτική' 23; also 24-29, 37-39 with words split across the wrap such as 'ανθρωπιστι κά', 'Σακελλά ρη'). Some labels belong to a different line altogether (13: crop 'για 5 μέρες. Δεν μπορεί να έχει 20 άρθρα' vs label 'είναι, ότι έφερε η Κυβέρνηση...'; 30, 32).
